go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Doc

exec go vet ./model
exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["title"],
  "goAdditionalFields": [
    {"goIdent": "resolved", "goType": "*Doc"},
    {"goIdent": ["isBool", "isObject"], "goType": "bool"},
    {"goType": "docMeta"}
  ]
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/addfields

go 1.26
-- model/extras.go --
package model

// docMeta is the embedded helper referenced by goAdditionalFields.
type docMeta struct {
	Tag string
}
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

func TestDoc_AdditionalFields(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Doc{})

	resolved, ok := rt.FieldByName("resolved")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Doc has no resolved field")
	}
	if resolved.Type.String() != "*model.Doc" {
		t.Errorf("resolved type = %v, want *Doc", resolved.Type)
	}

	isBool, ok := rt.FieldByName("isBool")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Doc has no isBool field")
	}
	if isBool.Type.String() != "bool" {
		t.Errorf("isBool type = %v, want bool", isBool.Type)
	}

	if _, ok := rt.FieldByName("isObject"); !ok {
		t.Errorf("Doc has no isObject field (multi-ident expansion)")
	}

	embed, ok := rt.FieldByName("docMeta")
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("Doc has no embedded docMeta field")
	}
	if !embed.Anonymous {
		t.Errorf("docMeta field expected anonymous (embedded)")
	}

	// Every additional field must carry json:"-" so promoted
	// members never leak into the marshaled output.
	for _, name := range []string{"resolved", "isBool", "isObject", "docMeta"} {
		f, _ := rt.FieldByName(name)
		if got := f.Tag.Get("json"); got != "-" {
			t.Errorf("%s json tag = %q, want %q", name, got, "-")
		}
	}
}

// JSON-derived Title still round-trips; additional unexported fields
// are invisible to the marshaler.
func TestDoc_RoundTripIgnoresExtras(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`{"title":"hi"}`)
	var d Doc
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &d); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if d.Title != "hi" {
		t.Errorf("Title = %q, want hi", d.Title)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(d)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != string(in) {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, in)
	}
}
